mn120:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.

mn120:2.3: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn120:3.1: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena samannāgato hoti, sutena samannāgato hoti, cāgena samannāgato hoti, paññāya samannāgato hoti.
mn120:3.3: Aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjeyyan ti.
mn120:3.4: So taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti;
mn120:3.5: tassa te saṃkhārā ca vihāro c' evaṃ bhāvitā bahulīkatā tatr' uppattiyā saṃvattanti.
mn120:3.6: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā tatr' uppattiyā saṃvattati.

mn120:12.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddhāya samannāgato hoti, sīlena samannāgato hoti, sutena samannāgato hoti, cāgena samannagato hoti, paññāya samannāgato hoti.
mn120:12.3: Sahasso Brahmā dīghāyuko vaṇṇavā sukhabahulo ti.
mn120:12.4: Sahasso, bhikkhave, Brahmā sahassīlokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati;
mn120:12.5: ye pi tattha sattā uppannā, te pi pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn120:12.6: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso ekaṃ āmaṇḍaṃ hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya,
mn120:12.7: evam eva kho, bhikkhave, Sahasso Brahmā sahassīlokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati;
mn120:12.8: ye pi tattha sattā uppannā, te pi pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
mn120:12.10: Aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Sahassassa Brahmuno sahavyataṃ uppajjeyyan ti.
